description: The WebSocketService class manages a WebSocket connection to receive price updates for cryptocurrencies from the Binance API.

classes.name: WebSocketService
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connection for receiving price updates.

classes.name: PriceUpdate
classes.description: Data class representing cryptocurrency price updates with symbol, price, and 24-hour change.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to receive price updates for a list of cryptocurrency symbols.

methods.name: getPriceUpdates
methods.description: Returns a Flow of PriceUpdate objects for observing price updates.

methods.name: parsePriceUpdate
methods.description: Parses a WebSocket message string into a PriceUpdate object.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Reconnects to the WebSocket after a failure.
